name: Tiago Alves
bio:
Tiago's passion for motorsport ignited early, spending countless hours sketching race cars and meticulously detailing model kits. This fascination led him to pursue vocational training in automotive refinishing, where he quickly excelled. His keen eye for color and unwavering commitment to precision landed him a coveted apprenticeship at a local body shop, specializing in custom paint jobs for high-end vehicles. 

Driven by a desire to combine his artistic talent with his love for racing, Tiago sought an opportunity within motorsport. He joined CRG Racing Team eager to learn from the best and contribute his expertise to the team's success. Tiago is known for his methodical approach, ensuring every surface is flawless and the team livery perfectly represents the brand. He's a firm believer in the power of presentation and the competitive edge a stunning paint job can provide.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part.
physical.description: Tiago is of average height, with a focused gaze and a confident stance.

quirks: Always wears gloves, even when not actively painting.
Keeps a small notebook filled with custom color formulas.
Listens to classical music while working for maximum focus.
